strategy_roster.name: Ichimoku Kumo Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(sma((high + low) / 2,9),sma((high + low) / 2,26)) and close > sma((high + low) / 2,52)
strategy_roster.exit_long: crossbelow(sma((high + low) / 2,9),sma((high + low) / 2,26)) or close < sma((high + low) / 2,52)
strategy_roster.notes: Ichimoku is unavailable; current-value SMA midpoint proxies retain the documented 9/26/52 Tenkan, Kijun, and cloud levels. The shifted cloud and short side are omitted, and no stop is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Tendency EMA + RSI
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,9),ema(close,21)) and ema(close,9) > ema(close,50) and ema(close,21) > ema(close,50) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA 9/21/50 alignment, bullish candle, and RSI(14) overbought exit are retained. The optional five-bar profit exit is off by default, the short side is omitted, and no stop is built in.

strategy_roster.name: 4H Bollinger Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(close,bb_lower(close,20,1.8)) and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1 and close > sma(close,80)
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,1.8), volume_ratio(20)>1, and SMA(80) retain the long breakout rule; the opposite upper-band cross is the exit. The short side and 4H-only execution context are omitted, with no stop documented.

strategy_roster.name: Enhanced Bollinger Bands SL TP
strategy_roster.notes: The prior-close lower-band condition and current re-entry are represented by a cross above Bollinger(20,2); middle-band reversion is an exit proxy. The documented 10/20 pip protection is not a percentage field, and the short side is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Long-Only Opening Range Breakout (ORB) with Pivot Points
strategy_roster.notes: The 15-minute opening-range high is approximated by the prior 15-bar high. R1 confirmation, session timing, one-trade-per-day state, and pivot-based trailing exits are unavailable; the documented 3% stop is retained.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Pro+ Bear Market
strategy_roster.notes: The documented RSI(11) upward cross above level 8 is exact. A recross below 8 is a conservative failure exit; the source's 0.11% fixed target is outside the requested 1.0-5.0 percentage-field range, so no percentage is encoded.

strategy_roster.name: ZMFX Stolid 5a EA
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,20) > ema(close,50) and close < open and rsi(close,14) < 30 and (rsi(close,15) >= 30 or volume_ratio(volume,20) > 2)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20/50) proxies the smoothed multi-timeframe trend, the completed down candle proxies PreviousBarDown, and the implication is retained with volume_ratio(20)>2. Stochastic/timeframe shifts and the short side are unsupported; no stop is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Charles 1.3.7
strategy_roster.notes: The symmetric buy-stop is approximated by a break above the prior one-bar high and range failure by a close below the prior one-bar low. Anchor, trailing-profit, trailing-stop, volume, and price-step stop logic are not representable in this DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Up3x1 Investor
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and (high - low) > atr(high,low,close,14) and (close - open) > atr(high,low,close,14)
strategy_roster.notes: The completed bullish expansion candle is represented with a body and range exceeding one ATR(14) as a normalized proxy because pip thresholds are not supplied. A bearish expansion is the failure exit; pip stop, target, and trailing levels are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Trend Follower Rainbow
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,4),ema(close,8)) and macd(close,5,35) > macd_signal(close,5,35,5) and ema(close,5) > ema(close,13) and ema(close,13) > ema(close,21) and ema(close,21) > ema(close,34) and ema(close,34) > ema(close,55)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA(4/8) crossover, MACD(5/35/5) momentum, and 5/13/21/34/55 rainbow-base alignment are retained. Laguerre, MFI, bundle offsets, and point-based trailing stops are unavailable; the long side is represented only.
